g.title: cluster_in
g.text: — carrot 1 m/s along the planned transit (max lead 1.5 m)

g.title: cluster_in_layer
g.text: transit layer — pad outside the own zone (drones 1, 2)

g.title: wait
g.text: — on the pad, PX4 SITL up
setpoint: hover over the pad; waits for a valid position

g.title: takeoff
g.text: — climb straight up over the own pad to
1.8 m (pad in own zone) or 3.1 m (transit layer),
then hover depart_delay (6 s for the middle pad)

g.title: in1
g.text: corridor north over the own pad

g.title: own1
g.text: corridor north over the own pad

g.title: patrol
g.text: — carrot 1 m/s along the NMOPSO loop of the own zone
(auto lanes + Voronoi zone, 1.6–2.0 m); lap_done at the loop end

g.title: in3
g.text: hold while the column is blocked

g.title: own2
g.text: NMOPSO legs inside the own zone

g.title: out1
g.text: transit layer: hold while the column is blocked, climb to 3.1 m,
NMOPSO transit legs back, corridor over the own pad
(own-zone pad: NMOPSO legs back at 1.8 m)

g.title: land
g.text: — hover over the own pad; hold while a drone is below in the column
MAVLink NAV_LAND every 2 s; 3 s on the ground → disarm

g.title: note1
g.text: — before any climb, descent or landing:
hold while another airborne drone is within 2 m horizontally
in the column the move passes through (max 30 s)
